headline: Binance Records $5.3B Net Outflows Following Major Security Breach
summary: Binance experienced $5.3 billion in net outflows and nearly $11 billion in total withdrawals over a 46-hour period following a hack. CEO Richard Teng stated that a recovery is underway with hourly deposits starting to exceed withdrawals.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and significant outflows or security breaches can create liquidity concerns and impact overall crypto market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange hacks and massive withdrawals can create broad market uncertainty impacting crypto assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A security breach and multi-billion dollar withdrawals at a leading cryptocurrency exchange threaten immediate platform liquidity and dampens broader market sentiment.
